runners_data.name: Hickory Lad
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who gets an uncontested lead but needs to prove his stamina holds at the business end having been second on debut

runners_data.name: Kodi Bear Light
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity from powerful Burke yard but lack of experience and unknown running style creates significant tactical uncertainty

runners_data.name: State Of Gold
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with concerning tendency to fade in the final furlong, making the likely steady pace potentially problematic

runners_data.name: Stay On Tab
runners_data.note: Sits prominent but has shown limited ability to date and faces a significant class rise despite the favorable small field

races.paceDynamic: Hickory Lad will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner with no obvious pace pressure from the small field. State Of Gold and Stay On Tab will sit prominent but neither has shown the early speed to challenge Hickory Lad's position, while Kodi Bear Light's style remains unknown. The sustainable gallop will likely see the field bunched turning for home with little stringing out. This race shape clearly favours horses with tactical speed who can position handily and finish, as the steady pace will keep everyone in contention deep into the race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Hickory Lad gets an easy lead and kicks clear 2f out
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader can dictate terms and prove too strong when asked for his effort in the straight. His proven form at the trip on similar going makes him hard to peg back when getting first run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Burke Newcomer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Kodi Bear Light shows early pace to sit prominent and travel well
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced Burke runner could have natural improvement to find and the steady gallop suits a horse learning the game. Quality yard's newcomers often surprise when stepping up in grade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Battle
scenarios.trigger: If State Of Gold and Stay On Tab both sit handier and the pace quickens 3f out
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners engage Hickory Lad earlier creating a more genuine gallop that could find out the leader's stamina. State Of Gold's tendency to fade late becomes less relevant in a stronger run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a messy finish where any horse could emerge, potentially suiting a horse like Stay On Tab who might have more natural speed than shown. Form becomes less reliable in a slowly-run affair.

Kodi Bear Light's early positioning - Burke's newcomer could have untapped ability but needs to show early speed

races.paceDynamic: Riffa Spirit will take them along from the front with no obvious early pressure, setting a comfortable gallop over this sprint distance. Fille Unique, Moretons, and Gillali Lass should sit prominent just behind the leader, while the three hold-up horses Pivotal Terms, Realistic Dream, and Data Fata Secutus will be further back. With only one confirmed front runner and no speed war likely, the pace will be moderate to steady, allowing the field to stay in touch throughout. This shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and kick clear in the final furlong, as they get the best of both worlds - a sight of the leader but avoiding the front-running burden.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Riffa Spirit sets moderate fractions without being pressed early
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get an ideal tow into the race and have enough left to collar the leader in the final 100 yards. Fille Unique and Moretons are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Riffa Spirit gets soft fractions and builds a decisive lead turning for home
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows the leader to conserve energy early and they prove too tough to peg back. The hold-up horses leave their run too late on this sharp track.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes surprisingly strong with Riffa Spirit pressed by the prominent group
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for the closers who have been held up out the back. Pivotal Terms benefits most from his recent Musselburgh win and strong finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Returning Gillali Lass
scenarios.trigger: If Gillali Lass shows improved fitness despite her 281-day layoff and David O'Meara's preparation works
scenarios.body: Her class edge from previous good form shines through and Mark Winn gets her into a perfect stalking position. The prominent style suits but the long absence remains a significant concern.

races.paceDynamic: Glasses Up represents the sole confirmed front runner in this 9-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms from the start without early pressure. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics (As Fast As Wind, Sycamore Gap, Lieutenant Lily, Cougar, Blondina, Star Of Markinch, Gallus Norman) and only Falaise Blanc likely to race prominently, the early pace will be comfortable and sustainable. This creates a tactical race where the tempo may not be strong enough to fully expose stamina limitations over this 1m4½f trip. The race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems, with hold-up horses facing the challenge of making ground against horses who haven't been softened up by early pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Glasses Up maintains his lead unchallenged through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old veteran exploits his tactical advantage and sustainable gallop, holding off late challenges with his 77 TopSpeed rating proving decisive. Hold-up horses struggle to make sufficient ground against a horse who hasn't been pressured early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and collapses in the final 3 furlongs
scenarios.body: Hold-up specialists get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks, with As Fast As Wind's superior class (OR 63) and Sycamore Gap's recent winning form proving decisive. The lack of early pace allows closers to time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Falaise Blanc can shadow Glasses Up and outkick him in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old gets the best of both worlds - avoiding early pressure while staying close enough to strike, benefiting from race fitness after a recent 16-day break. His prominent style proves optimal for this tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and creates a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: Lower-rated hold-up horses like Star Of Markinch or Lieutenant Lily capitalize on chaos and traffic problems affecting fancied rivals. The race becomes a lottery where class counts for less than a clear run.

races.paceDynamic: Rosenpur will set the pace from the front with Sugar Hill Babe and Curious Rover sitting prominently behind, creating a genuine speed setup over this 5f trip. The early tempo should be honest but sustainable given only one confirmed leader, allowing the prominent runners to track without being under immediate pressure. The five hold-up horses including Water Of Leith, Knicks, and Al Hussar will need to produce sharp finishing kicks from off the pace. This pace scenario clearly favours the prominent runners who can sit handy and kick, rather than those coming from the back over this minimum distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine but not overly strong
scenarios.body: Sugar Hill Babe and Curious Rover can track Rosenpur perfectly positioned to strike in the final furlong when the leader ties up. The hold-up horses will struggle to make up sufficient ground over this sharp 5f trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Rosenpur gets an easy lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back if allowed soft fractions early. His recent second at this course suggests he handles the track well and can sustain the gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too strong and the leaders tire
scenarios.body: Water Of Leith and Al Hussar can benefit from a collapse up front, though they need everything to fall right over this minimum trip. Both have shown decent form recently but face a tough task from their preferred hold-up positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Rosenpur goes too fast early and the prominents follow

races.paceDynamic: Giorgio M and Tattie Bogle will dispute the early lead in this 7f handicap, with both having confirmed front-running styles and recent form suggesting they'll press forward from the gates. Their dual-paced battle should create a solid gallop throughout, preventing the race from becoming a sprint finish. With most of the field comprised of hold-up horses (Qazaq, Catalyse, Mission Command, Black Storm, Carolus Magnus, Penny Mountain), the strong early pace will set up perfectly for closers to pick up the pieces in the final two furlongs. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and late runners who can benefit from the honest gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Giorgio M and Tattie Bogle engage in a sustained pace battle through the first 5f
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will perfectly set up the race for the numerous hold-up horses to close with their trademark late runs. Mission Command, Qazaq, and Catalyse can all benefit from picking up the pieces as the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If one of Giorgio M or Tattie Bogle can settle just off the other and kick clear
scenarios.body: The survivor will have enough left in the tank to hold off the closers, particularly if the pace becomes more measured after the opening exchanges. Giorgio M's class edge makes him the more likely beneficiary of this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Criminal Shore and Counting Cards can track the leaders without getting embroiled in early pace
scenarios.body: Their midpack positions allow them to avoid the early battle while staying close enough to strike when the leaders falter. Both have shown ability to quicken when positioned just behind the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Giorgio M and Tattie Bogle fail to go forward or one pulls up early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace, potentially suiting a horse that can make its own running from midfield. This would play into the hands of the more versatile runners.

races.paceDynamic: Pallas Lord and Drumcondra will engage from the start, with Pallas Lord's more aggressive lead style likely establishing the early tempo. Four horses (Alpine Sierra, Spirit Catcher, Esque Elegance, On The Bubble) all want prominent positions behind the leaders, creating significant congestion and potential interference approaching the home turn. The dual speed will create an honest gallop that should stretch the field, but the bottleneck of prominent runners could disrupt several chances. This pace setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the early scramble and benefit from the strong tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Pallas Lord and Drumcondra maintain a strong gallop while the prominent quartet gets tangled up
scenarios.body: The honest pace stretches the field while traffic troubles eliminate several fancied runners. Clean runs from the back become decisive as the early pace takes its toll on the leaders and congested prominent group.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If one of the four prominent runners secures a perfect stalking position without interference
scenarios.body: Alpine Sierra or On The Bubble gets first run on the leaders while their prominent rivals are still stuck in traffic. The winner combines the benefit of a forward position with a clean passage through the crucial stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pallas Lord establishes an uncontested lead while Drumcondra fails to match the pace
scenarios.body: The congested prominent group allows Pallas Lord to dictate terms without serious pressure, while the hold-up horses have too much ground to make up. Recent win gives Pallas Lord the confidence to control from the front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too hard early and the prominent runners fail to capitalize
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical speed matters more than stamina. Esque Elegance's recent form and lighter weight become crucial in a messy, slowly-run affair.
